title: Move sign-in to server sessions across the API and the web app
context: Sign-in is being rebuilt in two workstreams that ship separately: the API gains a session endpoint, and the web app's login form moves onto it. This parent lands the shared session type first, then checks the two together once both are in. Each workstream is its own plan in its own worktree; this spec only says who owns what and what waits on what.

decisions.decision: The session type lands in the parent before either workstream starts
decisions.why: both sides compile against it, so landing it once stops each from inventing its own

contracts.reach: the web login form is the only caller
contracts.decisionRef: The session type lands in the parent before either workstream starts

verifiedFacts.claim: the login form posts to the legacy cookie endpoint today

risks.risk: the session lifetime has not been agreed; starting at 12 hours

diagrams.question: What waits on what?
diagrams.mermaid:
flowchart LR
  P1[parent 1: session type] --> A[example-auth-api]
  P1 --> U[example-auth-ui]
  A --> P2[parent 2: sign in end to end]
  U --> P2

deliverables.title: Shared session type
deliverables.body: The Session type both workstreams compile against.

deliverables.title: Sign in end to end
deliverables.body: Once both workstreams are done, sign in through the web app against the new endpoint.

quiz.prompt: The UI workstream is ready before the session type has landed. What does `go` on it do?
options: authorizes it, adding a warning line
quiz.why: `after: [1]` holds go until the parent's first increment is done
quiz.decisionRef: The session type lands in the parent before either workstream starts

quiz.prompt: Who defines the Session type the endpoint returns?
options: the API workstream on its own
the UI workstream on its own
each side, for its own use
quiz.why: landing it once in the parent stops each side inventing one
quiz.decisionRef: The session type lands in the parent before either workstream starts

quiz.prompt: The UI agent edits api/auth/handler.ts. What happens to the edit?
options: it lands, with a note naming the API
it is refused until the API is done
it waits for a human to approve that
it is reverted at the next render now
quiz.why: the family guard notes a trespass and never refuses
quiz.decisionRef: The session type lands in the parent before either workstream starts
